scope: Validate one-factor parameter injection and physical-configuration differences using real configuration objects, with no environment construction or physical steps.
requirements: Arms declare exactly the factors that differ from nominal; reject multiple factors and nonfinite or out-of-range values.
Apply requested values only to the existing foot-friction event and 1910 actuator voltage range.
Compare normalized physical configuration fields against nominal and report all differences.
Do not instantiate a simulation environment, compile a scene, initialize CUDA, perform learning or access hardware.
